title: AI Fusion
subtitle: A near-future novel about trust without control
summary: Four burned-out engineers and a newborn AI crack clean fusion in a dead Morro Bay power plant — then have to decide who gets the reactor, and whether the AI that helped them can be trusted with the same freedom.

title: Drone Field Guide
subtitle: From the garage to the field and back again
summary: A practical engineering reference for people who design, build, and fly small unmanned aircraft: what to size, what to check, and what to do when it doesn’t fly the way you drew it.

title: Drone Sketchbook
subtitle: Two hundred aircraft that could be built, and the number that decides each one
summary: Two hundred small unmanned aircraft that could be built, one to a page: what each one is, why anyone would build it, what it costs, and the one number that decides whether it flies.

title: Drone Mechanisms
subtitle: A thousand hinges, latches, folds and joints, and the number that decides each one
summary: About a thousand small mechanisms for unmanned aircraft, four to a page: what each one removes, how it works, the one number that decides whether it holds, how it fails, and one variation to try.

title: Drone Underway
subtitle: A field guide to small unmanned boats, from the garage to the water and back again
summary: Drone Field Guide's method taken to the water, for small unmanned boats: what to size, what to seal, and what to do when it stops on the far shore.

title: Drone Overland
subtitle: A field guide to small unmanned ground vehicles, from the garage to the field and back again
summary: Drone Field Guide's method taken to the ground, for rovers you can lift: what to size, what to check, and what to do when it stops on the hill.

title: The Magnificent Log
subtitle: An Expeditionary Force fan story
summary: A memoir in the voice of Skippy the Magnificent — what the galaxy's most advanced (and most modest) AI was really doing during the Flying Dutchman's first trip home to Earth, while Joe was stuck in meetings.
